# pickle-based PyTorch checkpoints (.pt, .bin)
#  - pickle can execute arbitrary code on load
#  - loading a malicious file compromises the
#    machine before the model is even run
#
# safetensors format:
#  - stores tensor data only
#  - no executable logic in the load path
#  - closes the arbitrary-code-execution risk
